experiment.bypass: direct-1: query skipped after codec API availability guard; required session and actual hardware validation unchanged

experiment.duration_semantics: Cold phase actually submits one fixture loop in throughput mode; the driver seconds_requested field is not a paced duration.

definitions.paired_delta: direct-1 minus direct-0 at the same case and repetition; negative first-public delta means bypass is faster. Medians of paired differences need not equal differences of marginal medians.
definitions.first_public_endpoint: sink_entry_ns: first instruction in the public completion callback, not rendering or presentation.
definitions.first_admission_to_public: sink_entry_ns minus admission_ns for frame 0; includes parser, configure, sample/submit, hardware/callback and core handoff.
definitions.first_scheduled_arrival_to_public: sink_entry_ns minus scheduled_arrival_ns for frame 0. Throughput arrival is generated immediately before admission, not a paced remote arrival.
definitions.capability_stage: API guard plus optional VTIsHardwareDecodeSupported call. Bypass retains a small guard interval.
definitions.vt_session_create: Host time inside VTDecompressionSessionCreate; internal initialization/resource stages are opaque.
definitions.first_vt_submit_to_callback: Public library timestamp immediately before VTDecodeFrame through first instruction of its VT callback; not isolated hardware execution.
definitions.configure_unattributed: Configure total minus explicitly measured configure stages; excludes first sample creation.
definitions.reference_budget: 16 * floor(1e9 / requested_fps), comparison only; throughput mode does not exercise age-budget drops.

limits: One Apple M3 system, four balanced pairs per case; descriptive medians/ranges are not a significance test or cross-device claim.
Fresh processes and decoder sessions do not imply a cold OS, driver, decoder service, cache or powered-down hardware.
No pixel validation, Metal work, Qt renderer, presentation, live host or paced arrival in these timing runs. Correctness gates were separate.
The capability-stage reduction co-occurs with a similar SessionCreate increase. This is consistent with shifted initialization cost, but does not identify internal Apple work.
These cold results cannot establish default-queue16 paced recovery or a steady-state decode latency benefit.
Same instrumentation and output-pool queries are enabled in both arms. Stage logging occurs on controlled teardown outside the measured first-public interval.
No pilot runs are pooled. Source run files and hashes are retained as repository-relative references; derived metrics and first-output evidence are embedded for portability.
findings: Across all seven cases the median paired capability reduction is offset by increased SessionCreate time; no additive 10-14 ms first-output improvement appears.
Median paired first-public changes are small relative to capability time and vary in sign; assess exact case values rather than aggregating different formats.
Ultrawide AV1 HDR first output remains above the reference 16-frame/240-fps age budget in every baseline and bypass run.
